title: fix(play): prove.earlyoom-spares-the-session fails where it should decline
description:
# 🌙 dream: `prove.earlyoom-spares-the-session` fails where it should decline

kind: repair · owner: this repo · caught 2026-10-30, in 5.3.verification of #174 · red main

## .the cue that fired
a full `rhx play.run --all` on the tailscale branch: `💥 prove.earlyoom-spares-the-session —
failed (exit 1)`. the tailscale pr touches no earlyoom file.

## .the gap, precisely
two facts, and the second is the defect:
1. this laptop has no earlyoom: the binary is absent and the unit reads `not-found`, since
   `1.6.3.earlyoom` was never applied here
2. the play reports that absence as a FAILURE, exit 1. this repo's suite contract is that a play
   whose subject is absent DECLINES with exit 2 and says so (`play.run` reads 2 as "proved no
   claim"). so a box that simply lacks earlyoom reads as red, which is the cry-wolf shape
   (`gotcha.a-check-that-cries-wolf-gets-silenced`)

## .the shape of the fix
1. the play: read the subject first — `command -v earlyoom` and the unit's load state. absent →
   print `🌙 … earlyoom is not on this box, so no claim is proven`, name the apply, exit 2. present
   and the claim fails → exit 1, as now
2. clamp it: one fixture row with the binary hidden from PATH must exit 2, and one with it present
   must still reach the real claim
3. this laptop, separately and by a human: `sudo -v && rhx grove.provision --what 1.6.3.earlyoom
   --mode apply`, then the play runs its real claim here

## .why it is not done in the round that found it
the tailscale tree touches neither the play nor the bundle; the apply needs a human's root.
